key_lines: Seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer for an exciting opportunity based in Colac, Victoria. This role offers the chance to contribute to the planning, development and delivery of critical civil infrastructure projects while working within a collaborative local government environment.
Offering $59 per hour + super, this position will suit a Civil Engineer with strong local government experience and a passion for delivering quality infrastructure outcomes for the community.

About the Role As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting infrastructure development activities across a range of civil engineering projects. Working closely with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants and service authorities, you will provide technical expertise, oversee infrastructure works and assist in ensuring projects are delivered in accordance with approved plans, specifications and relevant legislation.
- Support the Infrastructure & Operations team and provide relief assistance to the Coordinator Infrastructure Development where required.
- Degree qualification in Civil Engineering.
- Experience working within Local Government, particularly in civil or infrastructure environments.
- Experience with development approvals, permits and infrastructure assessments.
- Current Australian Driver Licence.
Mandatory Requirements
To be considered, applicants must provide:
- Current Driver Licence (including expiry date).
- Current residential postcode details.
If you're an experienced Civil Engineer looking to make an impact within local government infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply now.
